description: This file defines a factory function to generate REST controllers for Mongoose models with tenant enforcement and various query utilities, primarily for CRUD operations in a multi-tenant environment.

methods.name: validateSort(sort, allowed = ['timestamp', 'created_at', '_id'])
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the sort string against allowed fields to prevent heavy in-memory sorts or unindexed queries.

methods.name: clampLimit(limit, max = 500)
methods.description: Enforces maximum page size limits for safety, defaulting to a minimum of 1 and up to the max value.

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the in-memory micro-cache if it is not expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Sets a value in the in-memory micro-cache with a TTL based on process environment or default.

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Constructs a stable cache key for list requests based on request parameters and query input.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant(req)
methods.description: Cleans incoming create/update payloads by removing client-supplied tenant/organization fields and injecting tenantId from request context.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant(filter, tenantId)
methods.description: Merges filter object with enforced tenant_id conditions, removing any client-supplied tenant fields, ensuring tenant isolation.

methods.name: buildCrudController(Model, listDefaultSort = '-timestamp')
methods.description: Generates a fully-featured CRUD REST controller for a given Mongoose model, supporting multi-tenant filtering, caching, sorting, and error handling.
